verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that USCIS online accounts can be created and accessed remotely from a computer, phone, or tablet. Nothing in the pack describes the sign-in mechanism: there is no mention of password plus MFA, and nothing rules out biometric liveness, in-person, or mailed-PIN verification. Remote account access alone does not establish the credential-MFA sign-in path the story requires.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
